caption: The drawing features a full-length, historical women's gown depicted in the foreground with detailed coloring and another simplified line sketch of the same gown from the back in the background. The main gown is shown without a head or hands and is characterized by a fitted bodice, wide skirts, and sleeves with ruffled cuffs. The gown is vertically striped in pastel colors, including shades of pink, red, cream, and a hint of lavender, with the stripes alternating in width. Ornate lace or ribbon trim decorates the front seams, neckline, and sleeve edges. The skirt is open at the front, revealing an underskirt with matching striped and ruffled fabric. The back view sketch outlines the gown’s shape and highlights the ruffled cuffs and collar, but omits color and detail, using only pencil lines. The background is plain, uncolored paper.
title: Dress
